name: RapidCare
tagline: AI-driven clinical triage and emergency care continuity network with automated ambulance dispatch.
description: Production-grade care continuity and emergency response system engineered for rural public healthcare ecosystems, resolving clinical delays through multilingual AI triage, automated dispatch, and multi-tier hospital routing.
problem: Rural primary health centres face critical disconnects during acute medical emergencies, lacking structured triage, real-time hospital bed visibility, low-connectivity support, and continuous longitudinal tracking.
solution: Built a full-stack platform uniting 5 distinct user roles via Socket.IO real-time channels, integrating Groq-accelerated Llama-3 clinical triage, multi-facility bed reservation protocols, offline-first IndexedDB field registries, and WebRTC video consultations[cite: 4, 5, 6].
metrics_and_highlights: Built for Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2026 PS 26133) covering 14 core public health directives.
Curated and geocoded a network of 25 real government healthcare facilities across 11 Maharashtra districts using Haversine distance ranking[cite: 4, 6].
Architected 5 role-based dashboards: Emergency Operator, Hospital Staff, Frontline CHW, Specialist Doctor, and District Admin.
Implemented automated failover from sub-second LLM inference to a deterministic keyword triage classifier for guaranteed uptime.

ai_triage_and_dispatch: Groq-hosted Llama-3 inference parsing unstructured symptom descriptions into validated JSON schema (severity, specialization, clinical reasoning)
Dual-path routing: auto-creates critical emergency incidents with instant ambulance dispatch, or standardizes referrals across facility tiers[cite: 4, 6]
Real-time bed-locking mechanism that auto-reserves beds on dispatch and releases availability upon facility rejection[cite: 4, 6]
frontline_and_clinical_suites: Field CHW portal with Web Speech API multilingual voice input (EN/HI/MR) and IndexedDB offline mutation queues auto-syncing upon reconnect
Live hospital OPD queue manager computing dynamic wait times and priority sorting (Emergency, High, Normal)[cite: 4, 5]
Telemedicine consultation module generating isolated Jitsi Meet WebRTC video rooms with post-consult prescription and follow-up logging[cite: 4, 5]
Complete 22-test diagnostic workflow tracking samples from ordering to lab report delivery[cite: 4, 5]
district_analytics_and_gis: Interactive Leaflet geospatial GIS visualizer displaying real-time occupancy markers (Available, Busy, Critical, Full)
District-level Recharts analytics aggregating 14-day referral trends, epidemiological emergency distributions, and medicine shortage thresholds
